name: serpapi_amazon_search
description: Search Amazon listings or retrieve one Amazon product page through SerpApi. Use for Amazon product discovery, ASIN lookup, bestseller/listing checks, prices, ratings, reviews, Prime eligibility, delivery and stock signals, product comparisons, and purchase research. Amazon searches default delivery_zip from JARVIS_DEFAULT_POSTAL_CODE when omitted. Recommended pattern: use engine=amazon first to gather and compare candidates, then use engine=amazon_product with a chosen ASIN for richer details, a direct link, and an image. If saving a focused product to Canvas, preserve its thumbnail by passing it as image_url.

engine.description: Amazon SerpApi engine: amazon for listing discovery or amazon_product for one specific ASIN/product page.

query.description: Amazon product/listing query. Good for product names, shopping phrases, bestseller/category searches, and buyer-intent requests like 'best weather station under 300'.

asin.description: Amazon ASIN for a specific product detail lookup. Best with engine=amazon_product when you want one exact listing.

amazon_domain.description: Amazon domain for amazon engines (default: amazon.com). Example: amazon.co.uk

device.description: desktop, mobile, or tablet. Default: desktop.

num_results.description: How many normalized results to return (1-10, default: 5).

sort_by.description: Optional sort mode. For amazon, friendly values like review_score, rating, reviews, best_reviews, price_low, price_high, newest, and bestseller are mapped to Amazon's documented sort parameter.

node.description: Optional Amazon category node filter. Useful when the query should stay inside a category like electronics or smart home.

rh.description: Optional raw Amazon rh filter string for advanced narrowing (for example category/attribute filters discovered from Amazon URLs).

min_price.description: Optional Amazon minimum-price passthrough. Keep the price range in the query and use rh when a precise Amazon filter is known.

max_price.description: Optional Amazon maximum-price passthrough. Keep the price range in the query and use rh when a precise Amazon filter is known.

delivery_zip.description: ZIP/postal code used to localize Amazon delivery results. For amazon and amazon_product engines, defaults to JARVIS_DEFAULT_POSTAL_CODE when omitted.

shipping_location.description: Optional Amazon shipping country code, such as US.

include_product_details.description: For engine=amazon, enrich the first candidates with localized amazon_product details such as Prime eligibility, delivery, and stock. Adds up to product_details_limit SerpApi requests.

product_details_limit.description: Maximum Amazon candidates to enrich when include_product_details is true (1-5, default: 5).

no_cache.description: If true, bypass SerpApi cache for fresh fetch.

optimize_query.description: For engine=amazon, refine conversational input into a compact search query before first request (default: true).

extra_params.description: Additional Amazon engine parameters passed through to SerpApi.

include_raw.description: If true, include full raw SerpApi payload in data.raw (large).

availability.setup_hint: Set SERP_API_KEY in the active mode env file.
